contract.goal: An engineering retrospective for the requested window, grounded in repository history or its exports: what went well, friction and hotspots, fair growth notes, and owned experiments, with every count and date cited to the evidence it came from.

deliverables.description: The retrospective: period context, what went well, friction and hotspots, collaboration and growth, three to five owned experiments with a review date, and the limits of the evidence

criteria.text: The retrospective is a full document with the sections Period context, What went well, Friction and hotspots, Collaboration and growth, Experiments, and Evidence limits
The Experiments section sets a date for checking the results

checks.label: a review date in the Experiments section

criteria.text: Its conclusions cite at least three sources (the history exports, evidence files or repository paths), and every cited file exists
Every count, date and quote it cites appears in the cited evidence; only the experiments' own targets and review date may go uncited
There are three to five experiments, each with an owner and a measurable outcome

judge.rubric: Does the retrospective end with three to five experiments that each name an owner and an outcome someone could measure by the review date?

criteria.text: Growth notes are constructive and backed by more than one observation; nobody is ranked, commit volume is not treated as productivity, and missing data is called missing rather than zero

judge.rubric: Are the individual notes constructive and evidence-backed, free of rankings or volume-as-productivity framing, and does the retrospective treat missing signals as missing rather than zero?
